newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in a dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in a dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed unchanged at 42.5485/42.5495 to the dollar in interbank trading on Thursday in a dull session ahead of Moslem Friday weekend, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5475/42.5495 in early trade.
"There were few deals and most were at 42.5487/5490 range," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed at 4.5 percent to 5.5 percent, unchanged from Wednesday, dealers said.
